subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

t _ r a s _ t _ s _ a _ _ _ t _ r _ s r t

options.text: s r t r a r t s a
s r a r s r t s a
s r t r s r t s t
s r t r s r t s a

solution:
The correct answer is option (4)

Given Series: t _ r a s _ t _ s _ a _ _ _ t _ r _ s r t

Option 1: t __s__ r a s __r__ t /__t__ s__ r__ a __a__ __r__ __t/__ t __s__ r __a__ s r t

Option 2: t __s__ r a s __r__ t /__a__ s__ r__ a __s__ __r__ __t/__ t __s__ r __a__ s r t

Option 3: t __s__ r a s __r__ t /__t__ s__ r__ a __s__ __r__ __t/__ t __s__ r __t__ s r t

Option4: t __s__ r a s __r__ t /__t__ s__ r__ a __s__ __r__ __t/__ t __s__ r __a__ s r t

Series pattern: t __s__ r a s __r__ t /__t__ s__ r__ a __s__ __r__ __t/__ t __s__ r __a__ s r t.

Therefore, only **s r t r s r t s a** follows the pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **s r t r s r t s a.**
